notes_for_editor: Only a state list entry and a Forest Lookouts page with a heading and county. Two WebSearch queries (Charlton County; Folkston and Okefenokee) found no record of a Winokur fire tower. The page's one image is the same file as on the Crisp County page, so it is probably a site template image; not used, no photos added. The list's Charlton County and 21.9 m (72 ft) match the brief; feet is read from the list's own values, since the header gives no unit. Status, access and history left unknown. Fact-check 2026-10-21: the index claim (Winokur under Georgia) was not backed by an evidence entry before; the sidebar index on the Forest Lookouts page lists Winokur between the GEORGIA and INDIANA headings, and the evidence now records that. The story's list-notes sentence was reworded so it no longer copies the list notes' wording.
